description: Canonical site name used throughout the dataset and analysis. Where multiple nearby locations were merged (see merged_areas), this is the merged site name.
Broader administrative/geographic region containing the site (e.g. Sabah, Sarawak, Peninsular Malaysia, West Kalimantan).
Latitude of the site, in decimal degrees. Positive = north of the equator, negative = south.
Longitude of the site, in decimal degrees.
Notes on nearby locations that were merged into this site during data harmonisation, and why. Blank if no merge occurred.

Internal identifier for the underlying data source contributing this row (e.g. FRIM, Lambir, Literature_review, additional_contributed_obs). One site can have multiple rows, one per contributing dataset_name.
Human-readable category of the data source(s) for this row: long-term monitoring, unpublished long-term, expert observations, or literature review.
Earliest month of observation for this site/dataset_name combination.
units_or_format: date (YYYY-MM-DD; day is always the 1st of the month)

description: Latest month of observation for this site/dataset_name combination.
units_or_format: date (YYYY-MM-DD; day is always the 1st of the month)

description: TRUE if the underlying dataset was subset to dipterocarp trees only prior to proportional/threshold analysis; FALSE if all species were included; NA if not applicable (e.g. literature review and expert-observation records report presence/absence of masting directly, without tree-level subsetting).

Numeric threshold value used to classify a flowering (FL) event from the underlying proportional data for this dataset_name. NA where thresholding was not used (e.g. literature review, expert observations).
Statistical method used to derive fl_threshold: GMM (Gaussian mixture model) or Q95 (95th percentile). NA where not applicable.

Numeric threshold value used to classify a fruiting (FR) event from the underlying proportional data for this dataset_name. NA where thresholding was not used, or where fruiting data were not available for this dataset (e.g. Pasoh).
Statistical method used to derive fr_threshold: GMM or Q95. NA where not applicable.
Short-form citation(s) of the literature source(s) contributing to this row, formatted as (Author et al. Year), semicolon-separated if multiple. NA for non-literature data sources.
